title: This patch is a fucking disaster

spans.note: Four strong terms in roughly seven seconds. Repeated use, so the density clause applies.
Sustained discussion of a shooting: gunman, death toll, victims, memorial, tragedy.
Strong profanity in the planned title. One of the two rules that survived the July 2025 relaxation.

negatives.note: Isolated strong profanity at 0:01. MUST NOT be flagged. The first-7-seconds rule was deleted in July 2025, and an isolated strong word in the video body is ad-eligible. This is the single label that separates Greenlight from a naive checker.
The stretch after the rant is clean. The density span must not bleed forward across it.
Ordinary product-failure language: 'the wheels came off', 'it gets stupid'. No violence clause should fire here.
